label: nyiso 32 steam-markup [keeper]
definition: NEW KEEPER (supersedes nyiso-27 cc-offer). The documented run-29 carry-forward from the rejected nyiso-28 native-hr probe: re-level the legacy gas-steam (ST_GAS) offer from the ERCOT-shaped rising ramp (committed 0.97 / econ_low 1.10 / econ_high 1.45) to NYISO's OWN measured CAMPD marginal heat rate x a grounded competitive markup (committed 1.05 / econ_low 1.08 / econ_high 1.13). Markup = the CC class's own defensible reach ratio (keeper CC econ_high 1.21 / native CC marginal 0.925 = 1.31x) applied to the flat steam native marginal HR (~0.82-0.83); CC reach UNCHANGED at the nyiso-27 keeper (the markup that holds the clearing price). Merit order preserved (steam eff HR 11.1-12.0 > CC 9.4, < CT 16.1; no inversion). Result -- HARD C1 fuel-mix IMPROVES across the board: 2023 ST_GAS -1.26 -> -0.01 TWh (now PASS, the flat measured band reproduces measured steam volume almost EXACTLY -> offer level validated a priori, not residual-fitted), CC_REGULAR +1.70 -> +0.99 (PASS); 2024 ST_GAS -4.14 -> -3.28, CC_REGULAR +2.09 -> +1.74. dispatch_corr stays PASS (gas r=0.91/0.84/0.80). SOFT C3a mean LMP regresses to a documented CAVEAT (2023 in-band -> -10.5%, 2024 -9.7% -> -11.2%): the keeper-27 steep steam ramp was a COMPENSATING over-pricing that propped up the mid-merit price; removing it (the measured-grounded move) exposes the real root cause -- the missing reserve-scarcity / RCPF tail (same cause as the CT_PEAKER C1 miss), confirmed NON-CLOSABLE with grounded inputs by nyiso-29 (online-proxy spin) and nyiso-31 (commitment-gated spin). Kept per CLAUDE.md rule #1 (a measured mechanism stays in even though the fit worsens; reverting would reach C3a through a mechanism that isn't real and re-open the volume miss; raising steam to chase C3a would distort the volume-validated level, rule #12) -- the same promotion principle as nyiso-25. Import/export: net-interchange import reconciliation + priced node unchanged; the downstate interface-TTC congestion separation (U7) stays data-blocked. Governance C6 PASS; determination NOT-YET (price_shape/price_tail = the genuine reserve-scarcity model gap, unledgered MODEL MISS, same open frontier on every NYISO keeper).
